summary.short_summary: Eglo has evolved from a startup into a multi-country influencer marketing agency since its founding in 2014. Carolina secured $190,000 in equity-free grants to develop the business, which now operates in Chile, Mexico, Colombia, and plans to expand into Peru. Projected revenue for 2025 is $3.7 million, with significant contributions from major clients. The proprietary marketing platform features a database of 20,000 influencers and supports detailed campaign metrics. The agency employs 42 full-time staff and targets a sale valuation of $6 million, preferring a cash-heavy deal with a global marketing firm as a potential buyer. Carolina is organizing 10-year anniversary events to enhance visibility and client engagement during the sale process.
